subject: dsa
title: Binary Tree Right Side View
summary: Standing to the right, you see only the last node of each level. Do a level-order traversal and record the rightmost node encountered at every depth.
problem: Return the values of the nodes you can see ordered top to bottom when looking at a binary tree from the right side.

steps.caption: From the right side, you see the last node of each level. Traverse level by level and keep the rightmost node at each depth.
Level 0 is just the root, 1, so it is visible.
Level 1 holds 2 and 3. From the right, 3 sits in front, so 3 is the visible one.
Level 2 holds 5 (under 2) and 4 (under 3). The rightmost is 4.
Taking the rightmost at each level top to bottom gives the right side view: [1, 3, 4].
